items.label: Enable chatter
items.description: Records can have a conversation and history.
items.long_description: A model still has to switch chatter on in its definition. Turning this off hides it everywhere in the organization without touching what was written.

items.label: Keep deleted messages (days)
items.description: How long deleted messages wait in the trash before cleanup removes them.
items.long_description: Deleting a message, or a record, only moves its chatter to the trash, where developers can restore it. Cleanup removes it for good after this many days. An organization can set its own value.
